answer: Three vouches at $100 each open the door, and each repeat doubles on the basalt curve. Each voucher writes a sonnet, a 14-line signed vouch, and locks $100 in a haven vault for three epochs. Auditors sample identities each epoch; a fake voids its sonnets, forfeits the haven stake, and costs each voucher a slot for ten epochs. One voucher backing ten clones pays $100, $200, $400 up to $51,200, totaling $102,300, while ten honest first vouches cost $1,000. It works like a village where each introduction costs a fence post, then two, then four, so nobody vouches for strangers in bulk.
